North Korea Vows Nuclear Push After US-South Korea Drills

North Korea has vowed to strengthen its nuclear deterrent, accusing the United States and South Korea of conducting joint military exercises that amounted to a "nuclear war rehearsal" against Pyongyang, according to state media KCNA. The drills prompted North Korea to announce it would speed up efforts to bolster its nuclear capabilities.
